title: Yellowed Greek Napa Cabbage Kleftiko
description: A comforting Greek dish featuring napa cabbage, this kleftiko is a pungent and shattering flexitarian-friendly meal, cooked to perfection in a bain-marie. The combination of napa cabbage, aromatic spices, and tangy feta cheese creates a truly unique flavor experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the napa cabbage leaves, olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Transfer the cabbage mixture to a heatproof dish and top with crumbly feta cheese.
Place the dish in a large bain-marie and add enough boiling water to come halfway up the side of the dish.
Cover the bain-marie with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender and lightly browned.
Remove the dish from the bain-marie and stir in the lemon juice.
Let the kleftiko rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the kleftiko hot, garnished with additional feta cheese and a sprinkle of dried oregano if desired.
